anchors.quote:
3.3 “Net assets” refers to the value that is calculated by deducting total liabilities from total
assets. “Net assets, excluding primary residence” refers to the value that is calculated
by deducting the value of primary residence from net assets.

assumptions: Input classification, account ownership and HKD conversion are supplied; residence is already included in assets.
Signed inputs are admitted as specified; no nonnegative floor or additional input restrictions are imposed.
interpretation: Compute net assets as assets minus liabilities, then subtract primary residence value. No SPI eligibility determination is made.
source:
```catala
scope Control:
  definition result equals (assets - liabilities) - residence
```
